header:
# Town of Orwell municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 17; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Orwell, Local Election Results 2026 page (signed by the Town Clerk): Glen Cousineau was elected moderator
Town of Orwell, Local Election Results 2026 page (signed by the Town Clerk): Anna Golann was elected town clerk; the SOS Guide's Elizabeth Walker now serves as assistant clerk

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names Elizabeth Walker as Orwell's town clerk (superseded by the town's 2026 results: Walker is now assistant clerk)
Town of Orwell, Local Election Results 2026 page (signed by the Town Clerk): Bryan S. Young was elected town treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): names Bryan Young as Orwell's town treasurer

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists the Orwell selectboard: Andrea Treadway (Chair), Mike Christian, Joe Pouliot, Hans Tudhope, and Les Wood
Town of Orwell, Local Election Results 2026 page (signed by the Town Clerk): Mike Christian was re-elected to a three-year seat and Les Wood to a two-year seat in 2026

Town of Orwell, Local Election Results 2026 page (signed by the Town Clerk): Sharon Ronchetti was elected lister for a two-year remainder of a three-year term; the three-year seat and the one-year remainder both returned Vacant
Town of Orwell, Listers page: names Sharon Ronchetti and states one vacancy; the second unfilled seat is created without a membership and no further holder is asserted

Town of Orwell, Local Election Results 2026 page (signed by the Town Clerk): both auditor seats that stood in 2026 (a three-year seat and a one-year remainder) returned Vacant, so the post is created without memberships
Town of Orwell, Auditors page: names no auditor and states 'Two Auditor Vacancies Exist'
Town of Orwell, Local Election Results 2026 page (signed by the Town Clerk): Bryan S. Young was elected trustee of public funds
Town of Orwell, Local Election Results 2026 page (signed by the Town Clerk): Gary Murdock was elected first constable

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): Orwell elects five justices of the peace; the listing names Stephanie Bruyneel Corey, Glen Cousineau, Michael R Audet, Richard O Buxton, Jr, and Lisa Limoge
